description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EndpointExceptionTrait' that provides reusable exception handling methods for API endpoints, including methods to generate specific exception types and validation helpers, within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

methods.name: getBadRequestException
methods.description: Returns a BadRequestException with a specified message.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns a NotImplementedException with a specified message.

methods.name: getRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Returns a RecordNotFoundException with a specified message.

methods.name: getForbiddenException
methods.description: Returns a ForbiddenException with a specified message.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfNotExist
methods.description: Throws RecordNotFoundException if the provided entity does not exist or does not match the specified class.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfEmptyIds
methods.description: Throws RecordNotFoundException if the provided array of entity IDs is empty.

methods.name: getInvalidParamException
methods.description: Returns an InvalidParamException containing InvalidArgumentExceptions for given parameter keys.
